label: Weekly Repository Brief
info: No-code source-grounded workflow: webhook → public source packet → format/review boundary → response. The caller fetches public source text because this sandbox blocks the local Node-RED HTTP node upstream.

rules.to: {"sourceName": payload.sourceName, "sourceUrl": payload.sourceUrl, "excerpt": $substring(payload.sourceText, 0, 600), "humanReviewRequired": true, "notice": "Check source relevance and evidence before reuse. This workflow does not judge quality, authorship, or impact."}
Confirm relevance and evidence before reusing any commit context; this flow makes no quality, authorship, or impact judgment.
